hoy.titular: Champions! The Pincha win the Supercopa and earn their 20th star
hoy.resumen: Estudiantes beat Independiente Rivadavia 3-2 after extra time in Córdoba, with a Lucas Alario header after their opponents had equalised in stoppage time. Now it is all about Montevideo: the Libertadores final against Palmeiras is on the 28th.
puntos: Coaches to Montevideo (ARS 50,000 return, in the UNO app): today, Friday 13, the remaining members; Saturday 14, general sale.
Seats for the final: sold out. The club will tell members if any more become available.
Saturday 14, 7pm to midnight: the Estudiantes Museum shows off its revamp at Museos a la Luz de la Luna, at the club headquarters (53 No. 620).

linea.texto: Champions! The Pincha beat Independiente Rivadavia 3-2 after extra time in Córdoba.
Carrillo, who scored the opener: "It's a bit of our way of life." He praised how the team recovered after the 2-2.
The winning goal: an Alario header in extra time, from a Baltasar Rodríguez set-piece delivery.
A bonus: by winning the Supercopa, Estudiantes will play the 2027 Recopa de Campeones.
With 20 titles, the Pincha are now seventh on their own in the all-time table, two behind San Lorenzo.
